t: Compass: Decision queue engine — surface decisions, track history, enable approve/defer/reject
description: The Compass vision is: 'Wake up → open dashboard → see 3 decisions → approve/defer → gardener executes tonight.' This lug builds the decision engine: (1) decisions.jsonl at WAI-Hub/advisors/compass/ tracking every user decision with timestamp + context + outcome, (2) decision queue scanner that finds items needing user input (high-impact lugs, teaching adoption candidates, Lathe shift direction changes), (3) decision cards in the HTML dashboard with approve/defer/reject buttons that write back to decisions.jsonl via a simple local endpoint or CLI command.
perceive: Read compass_report.py (now built). Identify where decision items come from: undelivered signals, open high-impact lugs, teachings needing manual review, Lathe direction proposals.
execute: Create tools/compass_decide.py CLI: compass_decide.py approve|defer|reject <decision_id> [--reason 'text']. Create decisions.jsonl schema: {id, ts, type, title, source_lug, action, reason, outcome_ts}. Add decision queue section to compass_report.py HTML generation. Decision items sourced from: (a) signals in incoming/ with impact >= 9, (b) work queue items tagged 'needs-decision', (c) Lathe shift direction changes. Each decision card shows: title, source, impact, one-line context, action buttons.
verify: Run compass_decide.py approve test-id --reason 'testing'. Verify decisions.jsonl has entry. Run compass_report.py, verify decision queue section shows real items.
acceptance_criteria: decisions.jsonl tracks all user decisions with timestamp and context
compass_decide.py CLI works: approve/defer/reject with optional reason
Dashboard decision queue shows real items from signals and work queue
Morning flow works: view dashboard → decide → gardener picks up tonight
